a) a virtual environment is needed for testing and enhancing the safety and performance of autonomous vehicles; b) the virtual environment should be able to recreate rare but important corner cases; c) Grand Theft Auto V is a good initial platform for the development of the virtual environment; d) a Princeton Virtual Environment (PV) is being developed for the training, enhancing, and testing of safe driving AI.
we can use a virtual environment to train and test a Convolutional Neural Network for the purpose of safe driving.
the use of virtual environments such as Grand Theft Auto V and Unity can be used for training and testing Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)-based deep learning in autonomous vehicles.

the use of virtual environments to train, test and enhance deep learning in self driving cars, with an emphasis on safety.
the development and use of virtual environments for the safe development of AI in self-driving cars.
the training, testing, and enhancement of safe AI driving.

the virtual environment of GTA V is a promising platform for the training and enhancement of AI for safe driving, and that the PVE is being created to address rare corner cases.
